description: Expected method error under the DUD-E class composition (weighted extrapolation)
row_grain: per-scheme-anchor-set-method (expected error under the DUD-E stratum composition, with the weights in class_weights)

columns.name: anchor_set
columns.description: anchor set the stratum-level error rates come from

columns.name: expected_error
columns.description: sum over covered classes of weight * class error rate, weights renormalised to the covered classes

columns.name: lo
columns.description: 2.5th percentile of the bootstrap (anchor molecules resampled within class, DUD-E composition resampled multinomially)

columns.name: covered_weight
columns.description: share of DUD-E ligands in classes that have anchor molecules

columns.name: unweighted_error
columns.description: the plain anchor error rate of the same set, for comparison

columns.name: class_weights
columns.description: DUD-E weights of the covered strata, stratum:weight separated by |

columns.name: label
columns.description: extrapolation label: this is a weighted extrapolation, not a measurement on DUD-E
